summary: Implemented S04T04 by adding read-only MCP directive tools for current work-item directive envelopes, directive compilation, and directive explanation. MCP current directives preserve CLI agentDirectives bundles and summarize directive, conflict, deprecation, and missing-required counts; compile/explain delegate to the existing CLI directive contracts. Added MCP regression coverage and documented the directive tool surface.
command: pnpm exec tsc -b apps/mcp/tsconfig.json --pretty false; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/mcp.test.ts; node apps/cli/dist/index.js docs check --workspace . --json; git diff --check -- apps/mcp/src/tools.ts tests/runtime/mcp.test.ts docs/architecture/MCP_SERVER.md
